decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper about training a genomic language model on genome sequences and phylogenetic data. It does not describe natural-language text, prompts, captions, or text-bio alignment, so it falls outside the text-bio scope.
evidence_snippet: “A Phylogenetic Approach to Genomic Language Modeling”; “training large language models on genome sequences”; “input data consist of ... a substring of the human reference genome ... and ... nucleotides from different species”
